jira.summary: Company Metrics, reshape LPR Recovery leaderboard to match Scans and Staging Live Hits

reconcile.method: Single prep pass on origin/main b999329615174f5e3c6bfe7f77e5c592f01c021a. Live Jira re-GET matches the intake on type, status, sprint, assignee, and acceptance criteria. Comment 41855 is the only comment.
driver_verified: Company Metrics cards() order in okf/concepts/company-metrics-dashboard.md lists unique-scans-leaderboard, recovery-leader, staging-live-hit-leader as keys 9, 10, and 11. Code is the grid. This plan does not reorder it.
RecoveryLeader heading is 'LPR Recovery Leaderboard' at app/Filament/Widgets/Dashboard/RecoveryLeader.php:30. getCardKey is recovery-leader at line 155. getType is bar at line 261.
RecoveryLeader::getData at lines 264-296 builds one dataset per kit across 13 monthly buckets and passes stack recoveries. Labels come from getGraphLabels, which are month strings.
RecoveryLeader::getOptions at lines 100-111 sets y.stacked and x.stacked true. interaction.mode is index.

RecoveryLeader::leaderboardForSelectedRange at lines 188-208 reads one window for today, last_7d, and last_month. this_month reads the last getMonthlyData bucket, which is the full calendar month, not month-to-date.
RecoveryLeader::chartSeries is the trait BuildsDateFilterChartSeries::chartSeries at lines 60-76. It sums each getMonthlyData bucket.

RecoveryLeaderQuery::handleSql at app/Clickhouse/Queries/RecoveryLeaderQuery.php:24-50 reads clarity.recovery_scans FINAL and clarity.recoveries FINAL, keeps _peerdb_is_deleted = 0, weights kit_count / total_count, groups by k.id and k.name, and ends with ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10. handle at lines 56-60 keys the map by name.
repo_date filters are Y-m-d strings. assertDate at lines 69-74 rejects anything else. okf/concepts/lpr-assist.md records the same fractional credit and says to filter repo_date.
docs/investigations/DEV-2654/recovery-scans-audit.md finds that query accurate-as-is. The view-without-FINAL gap on clarity.lpr_assists is a different read and stays closed out of this story.

StagingLiveHitLeader::getData at app/Filament/Widgets/Dashboard/StagingLiveHitLeader.php:229-238 returns one dataset. Labels are kit names from leaderboardForSelectedRange. That method at lines 268-289 drops key 0 and array_slices 10.
StagingLiveHitLeader::getOptions at lines 153-169 still sets stacked true. That is leftover from the old kits-by-month chart.

UniqueScansLeaderboard::getData at app/Filament/Widgets/Dashboard/UniqueScansLeaderboard.php:234-245 returns one dataset labeled Distinct Plates. getOptions at lines 100-157 has subtitle 'Top 10 kits by distinct plates', interaction mode nearest, and no stacked scales. makeDataset at lines 456-473 paints the max bars in success green and the field in zinc.
No Blade or JS file builds this chart. resources/css/filament/app/theme.css:67 says chart rules are omitted on purpose. The Chart.js options are the RawJs in getOptions.

Kit-user ranking is LeaderboardTableWidget at app/Filament/Widgets/KitUserRecoveries/LeaderboardTableWidget.php. It queries RecoveryKitLeaderboard. RecoveryLeaderboardExporter writes Kit Name, Total, and Rank. That page is not the Company Metrics card.

tests/Filament/Widgets/Dashboard/RecoveryLeaderTest.php:330 asserts the old positional month zip. test_repo_date_sql_compares_y_m_d_strings asserts the calendar-date SQL. The widget tests stub RecoveryLeaderQuery.

okf_cite.proven_stay: Fractional kit credit on clarity.recovery_scans FINAL. okf/concepts/lpr-assist.md related-surfaces table.
unproven: rollup or org-total parity with Scans and Staging
